title: 2016 AMC 12B Problem 6
statement: All three vertices of \(\triangle ABC\) lie on the parabola defined by \(y=x^2,\) with \(A\) at the origin and \(\overline{BC}\) parallel to the \(x\)-axis. The area of the triangle is \(64.\) What is the length of \(BC?\)

solutions.text:
Let the vertex in the first quadrant be \((x,x^2).\) By symmetry the base is \(BC=2x\) and the height is \(x^2,\) so \(\tfrac12\cdot2x\cdot x^2=x^3=64.\) Thus \(x=4\) and \(BC=2x=8.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Let a top vertex be \((x,x^2);\) by symmetry the other is \((-x,x^2)\)
The base is \(BC=2x\) and the height is \(x^2,\) so \(\tfrac12(2x)(x^2)=64\)
